rationale.ai-review: Uses multi-agent LLMs to automatically review code and detect security vulnerabilities.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps vulnerabilities to NIST and OWASP frameworks to produce audit-ready evidence.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides side-by-side LLM outputs and explanations to help auditors validate findings.
rationale.framework: Designs a multi-agent semantic RAG architecture for static application security testing.
rationale.built-system: Implemented a working prototype of Code Prism with a web UI.
rationale.general-code: Evaluates the system on general vulnerable code, not AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-security: Focuses on detecting and mitigating security vulnerabilities like OWASP Top 10.
rationale.method-experiment: Validators analyzed the DVNA repository under controlled instructions using the tool.
rationale.method-self-report: Gathered qualitative feedback from security auditors and UX experts on usability.
